name: studio-aegis
description: Personal music-production hub: references, notes, samples and deliverables per project.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w web && concurrently -k -n worker,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w worker" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
